# sspi_installer_bundle_remote (Resource)

Imports a software bundle into the SSPI Depot from a remote URL - the appliance itself downloads the file, so unlike `sspi_installer_bundle_local` no bundle data is streamed through the machine running Terraform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) HTTP(S) URL pointing to a valid bundle file. Must be reachable from the SSPI appliance itself, without authentication.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the imported bundle.
- `package_id` (String) The package ID derived from the imported bundle.
- `status` (String) The current status of the imported bundle.
- `version` (String) The version of the bundle.
